title: GenReasoning Debuts RLCR Framework to Build Collaborative AI Agent Organizations
summary:
Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards (RLCR) is a new training framework that develops language models into collaborative agent organizations that share a workspace and message board. GenReasoning used the method to train the 120B parameter Avalon-M1-Mini to study how models interact within this collective structure.

The company reported that the training led to the emergence of organizational hierarchies, divisions of labor, and increased verification through the recruitment of specialized testers and verifiers. GenReasoning stated the RLCR framework is intended to act as a laboratory for studying collective intelligence and the safety of multi-agent systems.

selectedTweets.text:
Introducing Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards (RLCR).

RLCR is a recipe that trains language models as agent organisations, which share a message board and workspace. We use it to train Avalon-M1-Mini (120B) and study its behaviour.

We find a number of interesting results, including:

🛠️ Learnt organisational hierarchies and divisions of labour
🕵️ Increased collective verification, through hires of verifiers and testers
👥 The rise of collective thinking, where agents think more about other agents and how to help them

We believe RLCR can provide a laboratory for studying collective intelligence and multi-agent safety.

Blog post and technical report 👇
